name: radio
gotchas: Radio buttons only behave as a mutually-exclusive group when wrapped in a `<mat-radio-group>` bound to a single `[(ngModel)]`/`formControlName` — MatRadioButton has no built-in grouping by DOM proximity or shared `name` alone.
`mat-radio-group` binds `value`, not `checked`, on each `mat-radio-button` — also setting `[checked]` on individual buttons while binding the group's value produces two conflicting sources of truth.
Changing `mat-radio-group`'s bound value programmatically does not emit `(change)` — that event only fires from direct user interaction, so don't rely on it to react to code-driven selection changes.
